Cape Town. Where the mountain is always watching... and so is the car guard.
From the passenger seat of a Ford... Raptor. The Rappy Tappy. standard issue for every digital nomad with a podcast... we observe a rare species. The Suitcase Dragger.
She dreams of doing the Prom walk like a local. But true Capetonians walk the Prom with a rescue dog, an iced matcha, and matching activewear. Never... a suitcase.
Nor will she hike Lion's Head at sunrise. The locals who did... will tell you about it. Daily.
So, she drags it through a wine farm. Locals call this, a quick tasting. It is never quick.
Up the Boo-Kaap, for the photo. The suitcase was not invited to the photo.
She has now placed it on her head. The Southeaster has opinions.
Checkout was at ten. Her flight is now now. Which, in Cape Town, could mean Thursday.
Behold. Kubbie, the app that finds a trusted local spot near you. A cafe. A guest house. The shop around the corner. Tap it. Book it. Drop your bags.
The suitcase is secure. She finally does the Prom... with a matcha. Practically a local.
So remember, Kubbie. Download. Store. Explore.
